checks.radiogroupName: How did the bank credit it?
checks.dialogText: Record interest Section 86(4) interest is the client's, less the Legal Practitioners' Fidelity Fund's 5%. The entry posts at once. Statement line Bank advice — no statement line An unmatched credit on the investment account's statement. How did the bank credit it? Gross — the Fund's 5% leaves in a separate debit Net of the Fund's 5% Without a statement line this is a bank advice: the Fund's 5% was paid at source, so only the client's share reached the account. Date credited Gross interest Fund's 5% as the bank shows it Optional — leave empty to use 5% of the gross. The bank's figure may differ
